concacaf.nations.league.how: Sixteen teams play in the top division. The twelve lowest-ranked start in a group stage. The four highest-ranked in the region skip it and go straight to the quarterfinals, where the top two from each group join them. Each quarterfinal is two matches, one at each team's home. The four winners meet in March for semifinals and a final.
concacaf.nations.league.history: This is the fifth edition. The USA won the first three, in 2021, 2023 and 2024. Mexico won the most recent, in 2025.
concacaf.nations.league.usRoad: The USA did not play the group stage. As one of the four highest-ranked teams in the region, it went straight to the quarterfinals.

concacaf.womens.championship.how: Eight teams play a straight knockout in the United States from November 27 to December 5. The four quarterfinal winners qualify for the 2027 Women's World Cup and go on to the semifinals. The four losers play one more match for two places in a further World Cup playoff.
concacaf.womens.championship.history: This is the 12th edition. The USA has won it nine times, including the last three, in 2014, 2018 and 2022.
concacaf.womens.championship.next: Semifinals are on December 1. The final and third-place match are on December 5 in Houston.
concacaf.womens.championship.usRoad: The USA and Canada went straight into the tournament as the region's two highest-ranked teams. The other six came through a qualifying competition.
